purpose: First production replicas of the Li 2025 pathway-3 (SO3^2- + HCHO) direct C-S addition, started from the published bulk and interface reactant snapshots.

what_this_is: Two independent production workdirs (bulk_r1_fix1, interface_r1_fix1, 64 MPI ranks each).
R snapshots only; the TS and P blocks of Figure 6b are not exported.
Ordinary single-CV metaD on d(S-C), 10 ps initial segment per replica.
what_this_is_not: NOT Li's three-replica free-energy statistics; this is replica 1 of 2 workdirs.
NOT a Liu 2026 five-distance-CV calculation and must not be compared with it.
No FES/PMF exists yet. HILLS/COLVAR appear only after a production job runs, and 10 ps at these heights is not a converged free-energy surface.
NOT the project's +2 K+ neutral model: this public snapshot has no counterions.
scope.structure_conclusion_status: No structural conclusion is drawn here. Any later C-S bonding claim must pass the three-layer gate in AGENTS.md section 7.

source.paper: J. Li et al., Nature Communications 16, 5187 (2025)
source.extraction: Element and xyz read per row from the block columns; nothing is wrapped, translated, rotated or reordered. Stored values are six-decimal literals (max |v-round(v,6)| = 1.8e-15), so %.6f is an exact reproduction.

system.counterions: none (no K+ or Na+ in this public snapshot)
system.charge_model_note: q = -2 periodic model. The two sulfonate charges are not compensated by counterions, so CP2K applies a homogeneous neutralizing background. This system is not the project's +2 K+ neutral model, and energies, densities or barriers from the two must not be merged or compared as if they were the same calculation.

production.dispersion: DFTD3(BJ) with REFERENCE_FUNCTIONAL BLYP (Becke-Johnson damping). Plain 'TYPE DFTD3' would silently mean zero damping; see docs/methods/mlp_plan.md lines 90-91.
assumptions: CSVR TIMECON = 100 fs is a project assumption; Li 2025 does not state it.
UPPER_WALLS AT = 4.0 A matches SI Table 3; KAPPA = 200 is a project assumption.

HEIGHT 1e-4 Ha (bulk) and 0.5e-4 Ha (interface), SIGMA = 0.1 A, PACE = 30 fs match the two pathway-3 rows in SI Table 3; both rows are printed as 3a, so the interface assignment of the 0.5e-4 Ha row follows the footnote scheme.
Our implementation uses ordinary fixed-height hills; the SI does not establish whether the published calculations used ordinary or well-tempered metaD.
1 Ha = 627.509 kcal/mol reproduces both requested HEIGHT literals.
Only the first 10 ps segment is defined here; continuation is a separate step.

fes.note: Nothing in this directory is a free-energy surface. HILLS/COLVAR are raw metaD output and would need convergence and replica analysis before any barrier is quoted.

cases.name: bulk_r1
cases.min_intermolecular_contact_metric: minimum-image distance, intramolecular pairs excluded; hard gate at 1.20 A

metad.note: ordinary metaD; no BIASFACTOR and no GRID/WT block. PLUMED PACE and PRINT STRIDE count MD steps, which equal fs here because TIMESTEP=1.0.

wall.status: AT = 4.0 A matches SI Table 3; KAPPA = 200 is a project assumption because the wall strength is not reported
